definitions.gloss: luxury goods, high-end product, premium item
definitions.explanation: A product or item of high quality and high price, often associated with prestigious brands or superior craftsmanship.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高級品|こうきゅうひん}⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦{扱|あつか}っている→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧。
examples.english: This store deals only in luxury goods.

examples.japanese: {高級品|こうきゅうひん}だ⟦からといって→からといって：30623_karatoitte⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧しも⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧わけ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Just because something is a luxury item doesn't necessarily mean it's high quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{円安|えんやす}→円安：04854_enyasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{高級品|こうきゅうひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Due to the weak yen, tourists from overseas are buying luxury goods in large quantities.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧ (high-class, luxury) and ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (goods, item). A straightforward term that covers any premium product, from fashion and watches to food and electronics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高級品|こうきゅうひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy luxury goods
- {高級品|こうきゅうひん}⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧: luxury goods market
- {高級品|こうきゅうひん}⟦ブランド→ブランド：05221_burando⟧: luxury brand
- {高級品|こうきゅうひん}⟦{志向|しこう}→志向：12607_shikou⟧: preference for luxury goods

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{贅沢品|ぜいたくひん}→贅沢品：17009_zeitakuhin⟧: luxury item — emphasizes extravagance, can carry a slightly negative nuance of wastefulness
- ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧: high-class, luxury — the adjective/noun form without ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧
- {一流品|いちりゅうひん}: first-class product — emphasizes top-tier quality
